description: List annual funding budgets - one figure per year, funding source (O&M or Capital) and workspace (module), which is what the dashboard Budget tab shows. Filter by year, funding source, module, site or building. Includes allocated, budgeted, and remaining amounts. Amounts are bare numbers with no currency: call get_organization_settings for currency_code before stating one.

module.description: Filter by workspace; 'none' for organization-wide budgets

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

name: list_budgets
title: List budgets
